WITH latest_cycle AS (
  SELECT MAX(cycle_id) AS cycle_id FROM skills.assessment_cycles
),
current_employees AS (
  SELECT employee_id, job_title
  FROM skills.employees
  WHERE left_on IS NULL
),
latest_assessments AS (
  SELECT a.employee_id, a.skill_id, a.score
  FROM skills.assessments a
  JOIN latest_cycle lc ON a.cycle_id = lc.cycle_id
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    la.skill_id,
    s.name AS skill_name,
    SUM(GREATEST(rt.target_score - la.score, 0)) AS total_gap
  FROM latest_assessments la
  JOIN current_employees ce ON la.employee_id = ce.employee_id
  JOIN skills.role_targets rt ON rt.job_title = ce.job_title AND rt.skill_id = la.skill_id
  JOIN skills.skills s ON s.skill_id = la.skill_id
  GROUP BY la.skill_id, s.name
)
SELECT skill_name, total_gap
FROM gaps
ORDER BY total_gap DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH rep_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    o.rep_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.ordered_on)::int AS year,
    SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)) AS revenue
  FROM sales.orders o
  JOIN sales.order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.ordered_on) IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY o.rep_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.ordered_on)
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    rep_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2025
  FROM rep_revenue
  GROUP BY rep_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS reps_higher_2025
FROM pivoted
WHERE revenue_2025 > revenue_2024

WITH rep_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    sr.rep_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.ordered_on)::int AS year,
    SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)) AS revenue
  FROM sales.sales_reps sr
  JOIN sales.orders o ON o.rep_id = sr.rep_id
  JOIN sales.order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.ordered_on) IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY sr.rep_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.ordered_on)
)
SELECT

FROM (
  SELECT rep_id, revenue FROM rep_revenue WHERE year = 2024
) r2024
JOIN (

) r2025 USING (rep_id)
WHERE r2025.revenue > r2024.revenue
